description: decide() stores approvedDiscountBps rounded down to a 5 bps grid instead of the reviewed discount
withdraw() sets the status directly and writes no WITHDRAWN history event
decide(DECLINED) no longer calls requireNotRequester, so a requester-reviewer can decline their own request
create() drops the active-request pre-check and active_application_id is always NULL, so the unique index protects nothing
decide(DECLINED) only rejects WITHDRAWN and SUPERSEDED, so APPROVED and DECLINED requests can be declined again
decide(APPROVED) no longer checks that the application is OPEN, so a request on a closed application can be approved
Extracts a requireApplicationOpen(applicationId) helper in the service; behaviour unchanged
Service: extracts a now() helper for clock.instant() in recordDecision, withdraw and supersede; behaviour unchanged
